menu_motion.doc: Page transitions of the field menu and its pages (M2-MNU-303; MenuMotion, docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Menu motion). A page opens by fading in and rising slide_px (at the 1920 x 1080 reference) into place over open_sec, and closes by fading out and sinking over close_sec; return_sec is the field menu's own fade back in when a page over it closes. Over the open world the scrim fades with it; a page over another menu keeps the backdrop (the same scrim and caustics) still and moves only its content. Reduced motion, or a duration of 0, makes it all instant. Every duration stays well under a capture's 30 settle frames (0.5 s at 60 fps), so a screenshot always grabs the page at rest.

dialogue_box.doc: The dialogue box's transitions (DialogueBoxMotion, docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Dialogue box motion). Shown, the panel fades in while rising rise_px (at the 1920 x 1080 reference) over open_sec; DialogueBox.dismiss() fades it out while sinking over close_sec, then hides it; a new speaker's name fades in over name_sec. Reduced motion, or a duration of 0, makes it instant. Every duration ends well inside a capture's 30 settle frames.
